purpose: Track the original game's systems and content against implemented behavior and independent evidence. This is an expandable inventory, not an exhaustive specification or a completion percentage.

reference.anchorRule: Timeline line numbers refer to src/original/MainTimeline.as. Embedded-class anchors identify the original SWF class and its method; export files are ignored, reproducible derivatives.

identityPolicy: Keep ledger IDs stable. Preserve original numeric content IDs during migration. Future additional content should use separate namespace-qualified IDs and explicit save migrations, never reuse an original ID or infer identity from display text.
evidencePolicy: Source inspection, port unit tests, browser observations and original-versus-port comparisons are different evidence. Passing tests or extracting an asset does not mark its entire feature complete. Update status only from a concrete implementation or observation.
